name: The Maiden (the foster-daughter)
description: Born to a poor couple and raised by a mysterious, noble foster-mother, her irresistible curiosity releases the star, moon, and sun; she chooses beauty at the cost of speech and is later made queen, suffering in silence until vindicated.
visualPrompt: A breathtakingly beautiful young woman with gentle, sorrowful eyes, long fair hair, and simple woodland clothing; she carries a quiet, mute dignity, poised and delicate, with an otherworldly grace that contrasts with her humble origins.

name: The Virgin Mary (the foster-mother)
description: A splendid, compassionate yet stern guardian who tests obedience through three forbidden chambers and later returns to reveal the truth, restore the children, and lift the maiden’s punishment.
visualPrompt: A serene, radiant lady in splendid, modest robes in deep blue and soft white, with a calm, sorrow-knowing expression and a gentle authority; her presence feels warm, holy, and unmistakably otherworldly.

name: The Prince
description: A determined young ruler who discovers the maiden by the spring, marries her despite doubts, and repeatedly pleads to save her when she is falsely accused.
visualPrompt: A young nobleman in elegant but practical medieval attire, kind-faced and steadfast, with an earnest gaze; he appears protective and resolute, marked by sleepless worry and devotion.

name: The Old Queen (the Prince’s mother)
description: Suspicious of the mute stranger and quick to believe the worst, she pushes for harsh punishment until the truth is revealed and her heart changes.
visualPrompt: An older royal woman in dark, richly woven garments and a structured veil or crown, with sharp, appraising eyes and a stern posture that softens into humbled relief.

name: The Three Children
description: The queen’s stolen infants, taken during three births to deepen her punishment, and returned at the last moment as proof of her innocence.
visualPrompt: Three small children: two toddlers holding hands and a youngest baby carried close, dressed in simple white christening-like garments; they appear safe and cherished, with a faint, gentle glow of innocence.
